entries.comment: STEP LOG P11-SCRIPT-AUDIT-001: Enter the Phase 11 audit without invoking any blind method or label consumer.
STEP LOG P11-CANDIDATE-001: Verify every nontransient Phase 10 candidate identity before removing runtime caches.
STEP LOG P11-CANDIDATE-002: Rewrite only the generated candidate inventory while preserving every scientific, method, checkpoint, operating-point, metric, audit, and report hash.
STEP LOG P11-CANDIDATE-003: Verify the corrected candidate and retain the complete removed-entry custody receipt.
STEP LOG P11-SCRIPT-FREEZE-001: Enter the authoritative Phase 11 freeze command with an explicit external custody root.
STEP LOG P11-SCRIPT-MATERIALIZE-001: Enter the only authorized pead-study-v3 scientific materialization command.
STEP LOG P11-INCIDENT-001: Append an individually signed event for the failed source-bundle access before any retry.
STEP LOG P11-INCIDENT-002: Verify the failure receipt, pristine one-shot state, and signed continuation head.
STEP LOG P11-ORCH-001: Run all tests before the signed freeze so later code repair cannot occur silently.
STEP LOG P11-ORCH-002: Sign the final method/report freeze before any key access, decryption, or materialization.
STEP LOG P11-ORCH-003: Execute exactly one custody unlock and materialization from the precommitted design.
STEP LOG P11-ORCH-004: Re-run the complete regression suite against the immutable materialization.
STEP LOG P11-ORCH-005: Run the final WorkPlan compliance audit before Phase 12 authorization.
STEP LOG P11-SCRIPT-TEST-001: Enter the complete Phase 11 regression runner with an explicit custody stage.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-001: Verify the final custody signature, frozen inventory, and v3 lineage bindings.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-002: Verify Phase 9A and Phase 11 holdout hashes and prove zero scientific design mutations.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-003: Verify access-profile fields, label separation, hashes, counts, and cross-profile case identity.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-004: Execute exact, nearest-neighbor, structural, graph, registry, and custody-source contamination audits.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-005: Verify the signed append-only custody continuation and one-shot materialization receipt.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-006: Stress signed-freeze and bank-count mutations and reject every invalid variant.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-007: Inventory every operational console log and its exact adjacent comment line.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-BLOCK: Retain an explicit non-completion verdict for every unresolved Phase 11 gate.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-008: Record Phase 11 completion and Phase 12 authorization in the mutable v3 execution-lineage ledger.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-009: Authorize Phase 12 only after every WorkPlan Phase 11 gate passes.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-001: Verify every nontransient Phase 10 candidate byte before constructing the authoritative freeze.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-002: Record and exclude ignored bytecode and cache products from the signed scientific freeze.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-003: Reverify Phase 9A signatures, ciphertexts, counts, allocation, and pristine one-shot state.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-004: Verify the custody signature and every final frozen byte before permitting unlock.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-005: Close the method and reporting surface under the new-study-version mutation policy.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-001: Verify the custody-signed freeze and every frozen file before requesting access.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-002: Re-run the exact public consumer and prove pristine one-shot state immediately before unlock.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-003: Authenticated-decrypt the three independently encrypted source, label, and seed bundles in custody memory.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-004: Verify every recovered mechanism, grammar, topology, interaction, intervention, nuisance, domain, seed, generator, allocation, distance, and ambiguity hash.
STEP LOG P11-MATERIALIZE-001: Generate the exact signed bank/track matrix once with hidden namespace-specific seeds.
STEP LOG P11-MATERIALIZE-002: Re-encrypt evaluator labels as a distinct post-materialization object and persist no label plaintext.
STEP LOG P11-MATERIALIZE-003: Publish only registered label-free method projections to the development repository.
STEP LOG P11-CUSTODY-001: Append signed custody events for freeze acceptance, unlock, every design read, every decryption, projection, label object, and one-shot consumption.
STEP LOG P11-MATERIALIZE-004: Verify the final bank counts, projection hashes, custody chain, and consumed one-shot state.
STEP LOG P11-MATERIALIZE-005: Close materialization without executing any model or revealing any blind label.
STEP LOG P11-TEST-001: Discover and execute the complete repository test suite in an isolated bytecode-free process.
STEP LOG P11-TEST-002: Retain the exact full-suite result without treating tests as blind scientific execution.
